svg.title: Hello, I’m George Vagdas. Full-Stack Developer from Athens, Greece.
svg.text: Full-Stack Developer from Greece, based in Athens. Specializing
in React & TypeScript, building fast, scalable web apps with
reusable components and sharp UI. Lately shipping native iOS
and watchOS apps in Swift too.
